text: And I know a lot of real faith though Listen, I ain't knockin' your hustle, do what you do I'm not here to be real, I'm just here to be true It's been long overdue, but I patiently waited Watching when MC rhymes while the next 100 faded The game is crazy, go from lukewarm to bubbling hot Then watch the cat who was ice cold come take your spot The changes are drastic, almost sorta theatrical How the scene shift from then to now, hard to imagine The slang changed just like the fashion Now cats getting killed though
